messages:
Sam (PM): Quick sync: post-launch we have two related but distinct asks from a couple of customers: (1) intermittent 502s on the streaming endpoint, (2) feature request to improve retry/backoff behavior. Customers want the 502s fixed ASAP; retry tuning can wait.
Renee (Eng): I dug into traces — the 502 spikes line up with spike in streaming buffer pressure on older Dedicated hosts. Looks like the new batching change increases memory spikes under certain token distributions.
Tobias (SRE): If batching-change is the culprit we can gate it with a FF and roll back on affected pools. Low-risk if we target only the dedicated pool IDs reported by customers.
Marta (QA): I can add a focused smoke that hits edge case token sizes (very short + very long) and exercises stream tear-down. Will run on canary.
Sam (PM): Plan: (A) Hotfix: gate batching on affected Dedicated pools and roll a canary within 3h. Acceptance: 502s gone for 24h on impacted tenants. (B) Enhancement: retry/backoff improvements tracked as a follow-on ticket with spec and customer-priority.
Renee (Eng): I'll open the FF PR with migration note. For the enhancement we should capture customer heuristics: exponential backoff + jitter + idempotency token usage.
announce-bot: CI green for commit cc7f2e. Canary deploy started to eu-central.
Tobias (SRE): Canary observations: 502 error rate -> 0.03% from 1.2% on sampled tenants. Memory pressure down ~18%. Scheduling global roll in 40m if stable.
Marta (QA): Smoke tests show stream teardown is stable on canary. No regressions on payload parsing.
Sam (PM): I'll create the enhancement ticket for retry/backoff with acceptance: reduced duplicate deliveries <0.5% and clear rollout path. Assign to Renee, with Marta validating. Design review next Tue.
Renee (Eng): For engineering notes on perf vs reliability tradeoff: we can keep the batching but add a memory-aware limiter and a per-pool tunable. I'll sketch options in the ticket.
Sam (PM): Thanks all — rolling forward if no objections. Will notify customers with mitigation and roadmap for the retry work. Closing this thread after global roll completes and customer ack.
